svg.aria-label: If India's truck owners were 100 people: 75 own fewer than five trucks, 15 own five to ten, and 10 own more than ten. Fewer than 2 in 100 use any digital freight platform.
svg.text: Fewer than 2 in 100 use any digital freight platform
Approximate. Sources: NITI Aayog / NTDPC, Redseer
